comment: Timers for the HUD mod, in seconds. bossRespawn: from a mid boss kill to its return, for the first, second and later kills; the mid boss timer shows only after it was killed, and the game's own countdown corrects it when the game shows one. events: match-clock timers. every: repeats on the clock; window: spawns somewhere in [first, first + window], shown from showFrom; hideFrom: stop showing from then (after 10:00 the bridge buffs come with every urn, so the urn timer stands for both); icon: the game image in front of the time; marker + respawn: the event's minimap marker class; while it is on the map the timer hides, and once it is gone the next spawn is respawn[0]..respawn[1] seconds later. Checked against deadlockitembuilder.com/timers, build 6722 (October 2026).
